claims.claim: This is a scrap LG Flatron TV
claims.evidence: Witness only confirms 'LG' logo on bezel; no model name 'Flatron' visible in the photo.

claims.claim: Currently not functioning properly / sold as is for parts or recycling
claims.evidence: Screen shows no picture and appears dusty, consistent with the claim, but witness cannot confirm power state or cause of failure from a static image.

claims.claim: No dead pixel, no line on the screen
claims.evidence: Screen is off/dark in the photo; no powered-on image exists to check for pixel defects or lines.
Witness explicitly notes no remote, stand, or cables are visible in the photo.
Internal repair history cannot be determined from an external photo.

risks.risk: TV may not power on at all (total failure vs minor fault)
risks.proof: Video of the seller plugging in and powering on the TV showing picture and sound

risks.risk: Screen defects (lines, dead spots, discoloration) cannot be seen while off
risks.proof: Photo or video of the screen while powered on, in a lit room
risks.if_unproven: priced as worst case, defective screen, no premium for 'no dead pixel' claim

risks.risk: Remote and power/AV cables may be missing
risks.proof: Photo of remote control and cables laid next to the TV

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage on back/sides (cracks, dents, broken ports)
risks.proof: Photos of the rear panel, sides, and port area

risks.risk: Exact model/variant unknown, affecting part value
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the model/serial sticker, usually on the back
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unidentified LG CRT model

proof_requests: Video of TV being powered on showing screen and sound
Close-up photo of model/serial sticker on the back
Photo of included remote and all cables
Photos of rear panel and both sides of the unit
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a dusty, powered-off LG CRT TV with no accessories visible, matching the seller's 'scrap, for parts' framing, so it can be priced at worst case (non-functional, no remote/cables, unconfirmed screen condition) pending the listed proofs.
